<select id="selectIncludingDeletedForUpdate" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.customer.dal.dataobject.customer.CustomerMasterDO">
        SELECT * FROM cus_customer_master WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
    </select>

<update id="updatePlatformFieldsByVersion">
        UPDATE cus_customer_master
        <set>
            <if test="query.updateName">
                name = #{query.name},
            </if>
            <if test="query.updateShortName">
                short_name = #{query.shortName},
            </if>
            <if test="query.updateRemark">
                remark = #{query.remark},
            </if>
            <if test="query.updateCustomerLevel">
                customer_level = #{query.customerLevel},
            </if>
            <if test="query.updateClassification">
                department_code = #{query.departmentCode},
                department_name = #{query.departmentName},
                market_code = #{query.marketCode},
                market_name = #{query.marketName},
                system_code = #{query.systemCode},
                system_name = #{query.systemName},
                expend_code = #{query.expendCode},
                expend_name = #{query.expendName},
                industry_code = #{query.industryCode},
                industry_name = #{query.industryName},
            </if>
            version = version + 1,
            update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        </set>
        WHERE id = #{query.customerId}
          AND tenant_id = #{query.tenantId}
          AND version = #{query.expectedVersion}
          AND deleted = b'0'
    </update>

<select id="selectIncludingDeleted" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.customer.dal.dataobject.customer.CustomerMasterDO">
        SELECT *
        FROM cus_customer_master
        WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}
          AND id = #{id}
    </select>

<update id="updateLifecycleByVersion">
        UPDATE cus_customer_master
        SET lifecycle_status = #{query.targetStatus},
            deleted = #{query.targetDeleted},
            version = version + 1,
            update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId}
          AND id = #{query.customerId}
          AND lifecycle_status = #{query.expectedStatus}
          AND version = #{query.expectedVersion}
          AND deleted = #{query.expectedDeleted}
    </update>

<select id="selectVisibleById" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.customer.dal.dataobject.customer.CustomerMasterDO">
        SELECT *
        FROM cus_customer_master
        WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId}
          AND id = #{query.customerId}
          AND deleted = b'0'
        <if test="!query.allScope">
            AND (
            <foreach collection="query.scopeSlices" item="slice" separator=" OR ">
                (
                1 = 1
                <if test="!slice.departmentCodes.isEmpty()">
                    AND department_code IN
                    <foreach collection="slice.departmentCodes" item="code" open="(" separator="," close=")">
                        #{code}
                    </foreach>
                </if>
                <if test="!slice.marketCodes.isEmpty()">
                    AND market_code IN
                    <foreach collection="slice.marketCodes" item="code" open="(" separator="," close=")">
                        #{code}
                    </foreach>
                </if>
                <if test="!slice.systemCodes.isEmpty()">
                    AND system_code IN
                    <foreach collection="slice.systemCodes" item="code" open="(" separator="," close=")">
                        #{code}
                    </foreach>
                </if>
                <if test="!slice.expendCodes.isEmpty()">
                    AND expend_code IN
                    <foreach collection="slice.expendCodes" item="code" open="(" separator="," close=")">
                        #{code}
                    </foreach>
                </if>
                <if test="!slice.industryCodes.isEmpty()">
                    AND industry_code IN
                    <foreach collection="slice.industryCodes" item="code" open="(" separator="," close=")">
                        #{code}
                    </foreach>
                </if>
                )
            </foreach>
            )
        </if>
    </select>

<select id="selectVisibleCount" resultType="long">
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM cus_customer_master
        WHERE <include refid="visibleConditions" />
    </select>

<select id="selectVisibleList" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.customer.dal.dataobject.customer.CustomerMasterDO">
        <bind name="pageOffset" value="(query.pageParam.pageNo - 1) * query.pageParam.pageSize" />
        SELECT *
        FROM cus_customer_master
        WHERE <include refid="visibleConditions" />
        ORDER BY id DESC
        LIMIT #{pageOffset}, #{query.pageParam.pageSize}
    </select>
